messages:
sara-support: FYI customer reported sustained 429s for /v1/generate during their midday sync (11:38-11:50 PT). They say it lines up with a cron that fans out ~3k reqs in short bursts. Asked for SRE help to triage.
liam-sre: on it — can you paste tenant id + a few sample request_ids / timestamps? any client retry behavior? @devin-infra fyi in case edge metrics needed.
sara-support: tenant `t-acme-42`. sample req ids: `req_01a2`, `req_01a3`, `req_01a4` around ts 1765439920-1765439980. Customer says clients retry every 1s and keep persistent streaming connections open. Link to logtail: https://logs.internal/acme/17654399 (customer redacted)
devin-infra: I pulled edge metrics for `t-acme-42` — lots of `rate_limit.hit` spikes between 1765439900 and 1765440000. Per-minute RPM ≈ 1.2k baseline, but short windows show 2.8–3.2k. Also seeing many concurrent streams from a handful of IPs.
devin-infra: log snippet from edge (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-18T18:05:20Z] tenant=t-acme-42 req=req_01a2 edge=proxy-5 rate_limit.hit=1 code=429 conn=stream id=conn-72 keepalive=1 retry_count=3
[2026-03-18T18:05:21Z] tenant=t-acme-42 req=req_01a3 edge=proxy-5 rate_limit.hit=1 code=429 conn=stream id=conn-73 keepalive=1 retry_count=1
[2026-03-18T18:05:23Z] tenant=t-acme-42 req=req_01a4 edge=proxy-7 rate_limit.hit=1 code=429 conn=stream id=conn-74 keepalive=1 retry_count=2
```
kaira-eng: thanks — this looks like a classic burst + retry amplification problem. Two quick asks to customer: 1) do they multiplex multiple logical users over single connection (HTTP/2)? 2) can they add jitter to cron or reduce concurrency? Also advise exponential backoff (e.g., 500ms -> 1s -> 2s) rather than fixed 1s.
liam-sre: short mitigation we can do now: temporary quota bump for `t-acme-42` from 1200 -> 2400 RPM for 30m to absorb the immediate storm while they patch clients. I've applied it and confirmed via console. Note: this only helps if requests are more evenly spread; per-second spikes still cause local ratecaps.
devin-infra: added a short-lived route-level smoothing on edge for that tenant (20s token bucket smoothing) to reduce microbursts while quota bump active. Watch metrics for increased latency — small tradeoff.
sara-support: customer accepted mitigation and will implement jitter + adjust retry policy. They said they use 4 concurrent streams per host and some internal fanout.
liam-sre: flagged follow-ups: ask them to report back after next cron run, request client retry policy config, and whether they're using HTTP/2 multiplexing. If they can't change client side, suggest server-side queueing or moving heavy syncs to off-peak. Marking thread for 2h watch. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0318-0037 — temporary quota bump + edge smoothing applied for tenant t-acme-42.
sara-support: will confirm with customer after next run and update ticket. thanks all! :heart:
